## Hello

I am a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia in
Vancouver. I came to MDS from a computer science background, where I spent most of
my time writing software and found that the questions I kept coming back to were
about the data underneath it: what it can support, what it cannot, and how much of
a conclusion is really there.

MDS is where I am turning that interest into a discipline — statistics and
experiment design alongside the engineering I already enjoy. I am most drawn to the
place where the two meet: models that are statistically honest *and* survive contact
with production.

After graduating I am looking for work as a **machine learning engineer** or **data
scientist**, ideally somewhere the same person gets to frame the question, build the
model, and ship it.

This site is where I keep my coursework, projects, and notes as I go. There is more
about me on the [about page](about.qmd), and what I have been working on lately is
on the [blog](blog.qmd).
